claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: No UnitRecord kind exists for species traits. types.ts defines only SpellRecord, ClassFeatureRecord, and MasteryRecord. Elven Lineage is a species trait and cannot be honestly encoded as any of these — forcing it into ClassFeatureRecord would misrepresent the source kind and produce a false trace.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: As an Elf, you have these special traits. ***Elven Lineage.*** You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: choose_lineage_branch
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trait requires selecting one of three lineages at character creation, each granting a different bundle of effects at levels 1, 3, and 5. No existing mechanics family models a branching choose-at-creation structure with per-branch effect bundles gated by character level.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage. | Lineage | Level 1 | Level 3 | Level 5 |

claude_proposed_widenings.name: spell_access_once_per_long_rest_without_slot
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The level 3 and 5 spell unlocks grant a prepared spell castable once per long rest without consuming a spell slot (and also castable normally with slots). This is a distinct resource pattern — a use_count=1 / long_rest_reset tied to a specific granted spell — not covered by any existing mechanics family. The spellcasting ability is also player-chosen at lineage selection.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_sense with range extension
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Drow lineage extends Darkvision range to 120 feet. The v4 atom grant_sense exists but there is no surface type or mechanics family to host it for a species trait. Range extension rather than grant-from-scratch is also a novel shape.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The range of your Darkvision increases to 120 feet.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_speed (species trait context)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Wood Elf lineage increases Speed to 35 feet. The v4 atom modify_speed exists but there is no surface mechanics family to encode it as a species trait effect.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_cantrip_known with swappable-on-long-rest
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: High Elf gets Prestidigitation and may replace it with any Wizard cantrip on each Long Rest. This is a novel resource shape: a known-cantrip slot whose content refreshes/replaces on long rest. grant_spell_access in v4 does not have a 'swappable' variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You know the Prestidigitation cantrip. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list.
